name: Safesight
tagline: Spot the small things that can make a home safer.
headline: A room photo. A clearer idea of what to check.
description: A closer look at Safesight, Noah Whiteson’s home-safety app.
overview: Safesight looks for possible safety hazards in photos of your rooms. It highlights what it finds, explains why it could matter, and suggests steps you can take. The idea is to make it easier to notice the things you might otherwise walk past.
image_alt: Safesight website showing its home-safety app and room scanning features
caption: The Safesight website introduces the room-scanning app. This preview is a snapshot of the site.
features: Start with a photo.
Scan a room to look for possible fire, trip, electrical, water, and blocked-exit hazards. The results point out where a potential problem was found.
Know what to check.
Each result includes an explanation and suggested fixes. You can review the finding yourself rather than trying to interpret an unexplained warning.
Keep track of the fixes.
Scan history, hazard tracking, and the House Score bring the results together. Mark things as fixed or dismissed, then return to your earlier scans.
note: Safesight is an awareness tool. It helps you know what to check, and doesn’t replace a professional inspection.

name: Undersphere
tagline: An FPS where gravity follows the curve of the world.
headline: The ground is a sphere. So is the game.
description: Explore Undersphere, Noah Whiteson’s spherical browser FPS and Most Unique winner at levelsio’s Vibe Jam.
overview: Undersphere takes a familiar first-person shooter and puts it inside a spherical world. As you walk around the surface, gravity follows you. That change affects how you move, how you read the environment, and where you expect the next shot to come from.
image_alt: Undersphere game preview showing the spherical world
caption: A look at Undersphere. The browser game is built around moving and fighting inside a sphere.
features: Follow the surface.
Movement stays attached to the curve of the sphere. You can keep walking around the world rather than reaching a conventional edge.
Think in every direction.
A spherical environment changes the usual sense of up and down. Navigating the space is part of learning how to play.
Open it and play.
The game runs in the browser. It won Most Unique at levelsio’s Vibe Jam for its take on a first-person shooter.
note: A familiar kind of game, with one change that makes the whole world feel different.

name: Volunteen
badge: Find a shift. Keep your hours.
tagline: A simpler way for students to find places to help.
headline: Find an opportunity. Make the time count.
description: A closer look at Volunteen, Noah Whiteson’s platform for student volunteer opportunities and hours.
overview: Volunteen brings volunteer opportunities, shift bookings, and hour records into one place. Students can find somewhere to help, arrange a shift, and keep a verified record of the time they’ve put in.
image_alt: Volunteen website introducing its student volunteering platform
caption: The Volunteen website. The platform connects finding an opportunity with booking a shift and recording hours.
features: Find somewhere to help.
Discover local volunteer opportunities in one place, so the search is easier to start.
Book your shift.
Choose a volunteer shift and make a plan to take part. Booking sits alongside the opportunity details.
Keep a record.
Verified hour records help students keep track of their volunteering without piecing together separate notes and messages.
note: Finding an opportunity and recording the hours should be the easy parts of volunteering.

name: GoSteer
badge: A wallet you can talk to
tagline: Check your holdings and prepare transactions through chat.
headline: A conversation with your wallet.
description: Explore GoSteer, Noah Whiteson’s conversational wallet for Solana and Ethereum.
overview: GoSteer is a crypto wallet for Solana and Ethereum with a chat interface. You can check your holdings, prepare a transaction, and review the proposal before sending it. The conversation gives you a way to work through the action step by step.
image_alt: GoSteer website presenting its conversational crypto wallet
caption: GoSteer’s website introduces the chat-based wallet experience.
features: See what you hold.
Explore your portfolio through the conversation instead of starting with a set of separate wallet screens.
Prepare an action.
Use chat to work through a proposed transaction. The interface brings the details together for review.
Review before sending.
Preparing a proposal and sending it are separate steps. You can look over the transaction before proceeding.
note: The chat helps prepare the action. The review is still yours.

name: Storebase
tagline: A familiar place for files, hosted on your own machine.
headline: File storage you can run yourself.
description: A closer look at Storebase, Noah Whiteson’s self-hosted file storage project.
overview: Storebase brings accounts, uploads, and sharing to self-hosted file storage. It gives your documents, photos, and other files a familiar interface while the storage runs on your own server.
image_alt: Storebase website showing its self-hosted file storage product
caption: The Storebase website introduces file storage you can host yourself.
features: Bring your files.
Upload documents, photos, and other files to your own instance. The interface gives them a place you can return to.
Share what you need.
Sharing is part of the storage experience, so keeping a file and passing it along don’t need separate tools.
Run your own instance.
Storebase is self-hosted. Accounts and file storage run on the machine or server you choose.
note: A familiar file-storage experience, with the hosting in your hands.
